what: Health-gate transient suppression needs os.environ membership, not _env_int alone
scenario_or_breakage: Implementing only max_transient_retries = _env_int("LARCH_PROBE_RETRIES", 2) ignores the max_auth_retries == 1 unset override; launch-time health gates (LARCH_EXTERNAL_AUTH_RETRIES=1) would run up to three transient retries and regress fast-fail latency
suggested_fix: Add explicit check_reviewers binding, e.g. if "LARCH_PROBE_RETRIES" in os.environ: max_transient_retries = _env_int("LARCH_PROBE_RETRIES", 2) elif max_auth_retries == 1: max_transient_retries = 0 else: max_transient_retries = 2; document that _env_int cannot implement unset-vs-set by itself

scenario_or_breakage: Cold-start or slow Codex exec can still hit LARCH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and emit probe-failed with no transient retry; part of the reported intermittency remains
suggested_fix: Track separately if timeout-path false negatives persist after rc==1 retries ship; do not expand this plan per approved non-goals
